name: What needs to be prepared before framing on a small addition begins?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be prepared before framing on a small addition begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before framing can begin, the foundation, slab, or subfloor structure must be fully poured, anchored, and cured, and framing plans must be finalized. Homeowners should finalize window and exterior door selections so rough opening dimensions are clearly defined before studs and headers are nailed in place. Additionally, the work area must be cleared of personal items, landscaping near the exterior tie-in point should be protected, and clear access paths must be established for lumber deliveries and staging framing materials around the job site.
acceptedAnswer.description: You need approved plans, an inspected foundation, confirmed window and door dimensions, and a clear path for staging heavy lumber and carpentry tools.
